app.name: PulseDesk

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.subtitle: Platform housekeeping. These actions affect every club.

waitlistSweep.title: Stale waiting lists
waitlistSweep.description: Removes waiting-list entries for sessions that started more than 48 hours ago. Such an entry can never turn into a booking, and customers already stop seeing it the moment the session starts. Claim links go with it. Attendance history is untouched.
